scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));for(const f of ['dependencies','peerDependencies','optionalDependencies'])for(const [n,s] of Object.entries(p[f]||{}))if(/^(file|link|workspace):/.test(s)){console.error('Refusing to publish '+p.name+': '+f+'.'+n+' uses local spec '+s);process.exit(1)}"
